title: Token Counting and Usage
description: Use ITokenizer, TokenUsage, and ChatResponse.Usage from Microsoft.Extensions.AI to count tokens, enforce budgets, and track real costs.

blocks.text: Token counting matters for cost control, context-window management, and capacity planning. Microsoft.Extensions.AI v9 provides ITokenizer and TokenUsage so you can count tokens before sending and read actual usage from provider responses.

blocks.title: Built-in token counting
items: ITokenizer - counts tokens in a prompt before sending.
ITokenCounter - counts tokens in provider responses.

blocks.title: Token counting and budget enforcement
blocks.content: Count tokens before sending and read actual usage from ChatResponse.Usage.

blocks.title: Use response.Usage for real costs
blocks.text: Do not estimate output tokens from response text length. Read response.Usage.OutputTokenCount for accurate cost tracking.

items.text: I can get ITokenizer from a chat client
I can count tokens before sending
I can read actual usage from ChatResponse

blocks.title: Lesson Summary
points: ChatResponse.Usage contains real input and output token counts.
TokenUsage makes cost estimation accurate without guessing.
blocks.takeaway: Use ITokenizer for pre-flight checks and ChatResponse.Usage for real cost tracking in production .NET AI backends.
